# FCIBlochConstruction

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FCI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FCI/FCIBlochConstruction`

```text
FCIBlochConstruction, version 0.01

Usage: FCIBlochConstruction [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 8)
    -x, --nbr-sitex : number of sites along the x direction (default value = 6)
    -y, --nbr-sitey : number of sites along the y direction (default value = 4)
    --kx : total momentum along the x direction of the FQH state (default value = 0)
    --ky : total momentum along the y direction of the FQH state (default value = 0)
    --model : model name
    --dump : dump the band structure used in this calculation to a file
    --boson : use bosonic statistics
    --pt : use Gamma-shaped parallel-transport gauge
    --csign : assume the FQH state is calculated using C with correct sign
    --band : index of the chern band (default value = 0)
    --fqh : filename of the FQH state vector (produced by FQHColorfulLLLBlochBasis)
    --output : filename template of the output vector. _kx_#_ky_#.#.vec will be appended
    --exact : (optional) filename template of the exact diagonalization vector

output options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
